classification_rules.EDGE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: sample >= 100 and one or more V5_HISTORICAL_EDGE_ESTABLISHED requirements fail
classification_rules.VALIDATED_PROFITABLE_EDGE: PROHIBITED_FROM_BACKWARD_HISTORY_ALONE; requires separately frozen protected confirmation lifecycle

economics.spread: historical OANDA ASK entry / BID exit

entry.base_fill: ASK open + 0.5 index points adverse slippage
entry.entry_bar: first complete OANDA M1 BID/ASK candle whose start is >= signal knowledge time
entry.stress_fill: ASK open + 1.0 index points adverse slippage

h1_resistance.fvg_geometry: completed c1,c2,c3 with c3.high < c1.low; zone=[c3.high,c1.low]

h4_target.confirmation_time: end of the complete H4 bar immediately after the middle swing bar
h4_target.eligible_at_trigger: confirmation_time <= H1 trigger knowledge time and swing_high > trigger_close
h4_target.selector: lowest-price eligible confirmed H4 swing high strictly above trigger close
h4_target.swing_definition: radius-1 completed H4 Swing High: middle.high > prior.high and middle.high > next.high
h4_target.tie_break: confirmation_time ascending, then swing source timestamp ascending, then stable swing id

holding.expiry_exit: BID close of the 1440th eligible complete M1 bar minus adverse exit slippage
holding.right_censored_dataset_end: exclude from resolved metrics when fewer than 1440 bars are available and no stop/target occurred

interpretation.historical_result_can_establish: V5_HISTORICAL_EDGE_ESTABLISHED for this frozen family on specified backward history
interpretation.next_if_historical_edge_fails: seal failure; no tuning; select a genuinely independent preregistered family
interpretation.next_if_historical_edge_passes: immediately preregister a protected confirmation protocol before accessing its outcomes

intrabar_order.entry_minute_events: entry at M1 open; subsequent BID high/low may resolve in same complete M1 bar

market_data.instrument_identity: OANDA US Nas 100 CFD/proxy; not CME NQ futures equivalence

no_resistance_signal.condition: after selected resistance is marked disrespected, zero other formed active bearish H1 FVG zones intersect the open interval
no_resistance_signal.other_resistance_state: each other bearish H1 FVG is active until its own first frozen 2CR disrespect knowledge time; FVGs without a qualifying pair/disrespect remain active
no_resistance_signal.selected_resistance: a bearish H1 FVG at its own first 2CR disrespect event
no_resistance_signal.signal_knowledge_time: selected resistance disrespect H1 close time
no_resistance_signal.target: deterministic eligible H4 Swing High selected under h4_target

risk.gap_stop_fill: use adverse BID open when open is below stop, otherwise stop anchor, then apply adverse exit slippage
risk.stop_anchor: minimum H1 low of frozen 2CR pair for selected resistance
risk.stop_event: first eligible M1 BID low <= stop anchor

engine_conventions: H4 radius-1 confirmed Swing High target class and deterministic nearest-overhead selector
H1 bearish FVG as the sole operational opposing-resistance class
project FVG geometry reused as an engine convention
existing V3-C deterministic contiguous-H1 2CR interaction/rejection machinery reused for resistance disrespect
No-Resistance means no other formed and not-yet-disrespected bearish H1 FVG intersects the open interval between trigger close and selected H4 target
immediate market entry at first eligible M1 ASK open after trigger knowledge
stop at minimum low of frozen H1 rejection pair
source_grounded_core: Area of Opportunity is the price area between a trigger and a target; participation occurs when price trades into that AoO
opposing PD arrays are resistance to a directional thesis
2CR respect/disrespect is an argument mechanism and running/closing through a rejection high removes a bearish opposing argument
Swing High is an admissible PD-array/target concept
index examples show resistance disrespect followed by lower-timeframe involvement toward the next target

staged_access.stage_1: freeze this deterministic derived protocol; no V5 market data or economic outcomes
staged_access.stage_2: after protocol merge, reconstruct H4/H1 structure and seal trigger set only
staged_access.stage_3: after trigger-seal merge and exact pre-M1 reconstruction, retrieve only M1 BID/ASK windows required by sealed triggers
staged_access.stage_4: evaluate frozen base/stress historical economics exactly once

target_execution.fill: target anchor minus adverse exit slippage; favorable gap improvement is not credited
target_execution.target_anchor: selected causal H4 Swing High price, frozen at trigger knowledge time
target_execution.target_event: first eligible M1 BID high >= target anchor

two_candle_rejection.disrespect: first later complete H1 close strictly above rejection_high
two_candle_rejection.interaction: bar high-low interval intersects bearish FVG zone
two_candle_rejection.multiple_pair_policy: first causally qualifying pair only per bearish FVG
two_candle_rejection.pair: earliest contiguous complete H1 pair at/after FVG knowledge whose bars interact with the FVG zone and for which at least one bar has high >= zone.lower and close < zone.lower
two_candle_rejection.reject_a: a interacts and a.high >= zone.lower and a.close < zone.lower
two_candle_rejection.reject_b: b interacts and b.high >= zone.lower and b.close < zone.lower
two_candle_rejection.selected_rejection: b when reject_b is true, otherwise a
